title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:BUMPER ASSEMBLY (370,000 affected)
summary: THE U-CLIP STYLE NUTS THAT RETAIN THE FRONT BUMPERS TO THE FRONT BUMPER INNER ARMS CAN FRACTURE.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:FLEXIBLE (2,306 affected)
summary: THE THROTTLE CABLE'S TUBE (OUTER CASING) CONTAINS A BEND THAT LEADS TO INCREASED LOADING OF THE INNER CABLE, CAUSING IT TO BREAK.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:REAR (157,740 affected)
summary: VEHICLE FAILS TO CONFORM TO FMVSS NO. 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES." THE SAFETY BELT OF THE LEFT THIRD ROW SEAT ON THE SIX PASSENGER VAN AND THE CENTER SECOND ROW SEAT OF THE SEVEN PASSENGER VAN MAY LOCK UP AND CANNOT BE WITHDRAWN FROM THE RETRACTOR.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: EXHAUST/CRANKCASE EMISSION CONTROL DEVICES (5,900 affected)
summary: HIGH AMBIENT ENGINE COMPARTMENT TEMPERATURES ARE EXPERIENCED AFTER THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED AND THEN PARKED. IF THE VEHICLE IS RESTARTED A SHORT TIME LATER AND THE CHARCOAL CANISTER IS SATURATED WITH FUEL, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT FUEL VAPOR MAY BE EXPELLED THROUGH THE INLET VENT LINE OF THE CANISTER ONTO THE ELECTRIC AUXILIARY RADIATOR FAN PRERESISTOR.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:FLEXIBLE (10,646 affected)
summary: DURING ASSEMBLY, WATER MAY HAVE ENTERED THE ACCELERATOR CONTROL CABLE CONDUIT CAUSING IT TO DEVELOP A HIGH EFFORT AND/OR BINDING CONDITION IN VERY COLD WEATHER.

title: General Motors, LLC: STEERING:UNKNOWN TYPE:SHAFT LOWER WORM (9,673 affected)
summary: THE INTERMEDIATE STEERING SHAFT WAS ASSEMBLED WITH LOOSE OR MISSING UPPER AND LOWER PINCH BOLTS WHICH MAY CAUSE SEPARATION OF THE SHAFT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:ANTI-SKID SYSTEM (2,700 affected)
summary: THE ABS BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER REAR SEAL ALLOWS AIR TO ENTER THE BRAKE SYSTEM, CAUSING SPONGY BRAKES OR PARTIAL BRAKE SYSTEM LOSS.

title: DOLPHIN RV PRODUCTS INC.: FUEL:LPG LINES:NON-METALLIC (212 affected)
summary: INCORRECT LP GAS HOSES WERE INSTALLED BETWEEN THE LPG TANK AND THE LPG PRESSURE REGULATORS. THESE HOSES ARE NOT APPROVED FOR USE AT THE PRESSURE AT WHICH THEY ARE OPERATING AND MAY RUPTURE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HEATER CORE:WATER (125,000 affected)
summary: THE END CAP CONNECTING THE HEAT EXCHANGER'S CORE TO THE ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM COULD RUPTURE AND ALLOW HOT COOLANT TO ESCAPE INTO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (9,000 affected)
summary: TWO FUEL TANK SUPPORT STRAP ATTACHING STUDS WERE NOT ADEQUATELY TIGHTENED, WHICH COULD CAUSE ONE OR BOTH OF THE STRAP(S) TO SEPARATE, MISLOCATING THE FUEL TANKS OR ALLOW COMPLETE SEPARATION OF THE FUEL TANK FROM THE VEHICLE.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:DRIVER (65,000 affected)
summary: IN SOME UNDERBODY IMPACTS THE AIRBAG SENSOR ACTIVATES AND SENDS A SIGNAL TO THE AIRBAG, LOCATED IN THE CENTER OF THE STEERING WHEEL, CAUSING THE DRIVER'S SIDE AIRBAG TO INFLATE.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING (49,047 affected)
summary: IN THE EVENT OF A PRIMARY ACCELERATOR CONTROL SPRING FAILURE, THE SECONDARY (BACK-UP) ACCELERATOR CONTROL RETURN SPRING WILL NOT RETURN THE THROTTLE TO THE FULLY CLOSED POSITION, AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS NO. 124, "ACCELERATOR CONTROL SYSTEM."

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER:MOTOR (790 affected)
summary: CONTACT MAY OCCUR BETWEEN THE WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR AND A HUCK BOLT COLLAR WHICH CAUSES A GEAR WITHIN THE MOTOR TO FRACTURE RESULTING IN COMPLETE FAILURE OF THE WINDSHIELD WIPER SYSTEM.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (458 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRICAL CABLE BETWEEN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT AND THE GENERATOR COMPARTMENT IS ROUTED TOO CLOSE TO THE LEFT-HAND ENGINE EXHAUST MANIFOLD WHICH CAUSES THE CABLE INSULATION TO MELT AND POSSIBLY CATCH ON FIRE.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BRAKES:AIR:DRUM AND SHOE SYSTEMS:CHAMBER:BRAKE (122 affected)
summary: AN INCORRECT SIZE BRAKE CHAMBER MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ON THE FRONT AND/OR REAR BRAKE ASSEMBLIES WHICH COULD AFFECT THE BRAKE BALANCE AND STOPPING DISTANCE.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS (22,862 affected)
summary: THE THIRD ROW SAFETY BELT RETRACTORS MAY BE INSTALLED INCORRECTLY AND MAY LOCK-UP WHEN THE VEHICLE IS ON SLOPES OF LESS THAN 15 DEGREES, WHICH DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."

title: General Motors, LLC: STEERING:GEAR:SHAFT LOWER FLEXIBLE PINION (2,502 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH A LOWER STEERING SHAFT THAT CAN SEPARATE DUE TO A MISLOCATED WELD.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (117,200 affected)
summary: THE FUEL TANK FILLER PIPES WERE NOT MANUFACTURED TO SPECIFICATION WHICH CAUSED LOSS OF FUEL BETWEEN THE FUEL TANK FILLER PIPE AND THE VENT TUBE DURING A TEST. THE LOSS OF FUEL WAS IN EXCESS OF THE AMOUNT PERMITTED BY FMVSS NO. 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC POWER ACCESSORIES:WINDOWS (1,400 affected)
summary: THE REMOTE ACTIVATION DEVICE CAN CLOSE WINDOWS AND SUNROOF FROM A DISTANCE GREATER THAN THE MAXIMUM (6 METERS) PERMITTED BY FMVSS NO.118, "POWER OPERATED WINDOW SYSTEMS."

title: FBS, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (5,000 affected)
summary: THE TWEED CAR SEAT COVER FABRIC DOES NOT MEET THE MINIMUM FLAMMABILITY REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS."
